units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:19">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … אפי׳ ק׳</he> whatever people make their ruler (worship), be it a stone, or a piece of wood, v. <cite ref="M00511"><he>מוֹלֶךְ</he></cite>; Y. ib. VII, 25ᶜ top.
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:18">Tosef. Bets. III, 18</cite> <he>ק׳ לחצות וכ׳</he> a chip with which to pick his teeth.

B. Bath. 15ᵇ ‘a generation which judges its judges’, אומר לו טול ק׳ מבין עיניך וכ׳ (Ms. O. קוצא thorn; Ms. H. ק׳ מבין שיניך) when he says to a person, take the chip out of thy eye (teeth), he answers, take the beam &c.; Arakh. 16ᵇ (Var. שיניך); a. fr.—Pl. קִיסְּמִים, קִיסְּמִין.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:6">Sabb. VI, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 65a:12">65ᵃ</cite>) <he>בק׳ שבאזניהם</he> (Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70 cites <he>קוס׳</he>; in Rashi a. Bart. <he>קִסְּמִ׳</he>) with chips in their ears (to prevent the growing up of the perforations); Y. ib. VI, 8ᶜ <he>אבל לא בק׳ וכ׳</he> but they must not (go out on the Sabbath) with chips &c.; a. e.
